newPlatforms.activityVerification: UMFM's official homepage contained news dated July 6, 2026, current events and live schedule data. newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: A human must select an eligible release, confirm whether digital singles and international submissions are accepted, prepare a secure downloadable link, avoid direct audio attachments, use the official protected Program Director email action without decoding or guessing the address, and send manually. Physical submissions require an eligible CD, postage and customs handling. Stop if a CAPTCHA, login, mandatory payment or new restriction appears.

deduplication.result: Repository code searches returned no prior canonical CKUW or UMFM/CJUM submission opportunity. CKUW's digital Music Director route and four physical formats were consolidated into one record; general office, request, interview and feedback contacts were excluded. UMFM's multiple approved download-link services and physical-CD route were consolidated into one record; general, PSA, advertising, sponsorship and live-session contacts were excluded.

notes: Both opportunities are free-first, first-party radio-airplay routes and remain needs_manual_review. CKUW provides one verified public Music Director mailbox plus a high-quality download-link route and four physical formats. UMFM provides a protected first-party Program Director email action for secure download links and an authorized CD route; its address was not decoded or guessed. No email, form, audio attachment, download link, physical package, login, CAPTCHA or payment was submitted or bypassed.
